title: A land that stops after it removed the worker's worktree prints the command that brings the worktree back for the fix
goal: When backlog.py land stops at a step after it released the worker's worktree (lint, eval, stale, a failed push), its stop message names the git worktree add command that checks work/<id> out again at the same path, so the orchestrator fixes the branch without finding the path by hand; at SP-up5wchen the land of ST-4ehra2pk stopped at lint twice and the orchestrator re-added the removed worktree each time.

clauses.clause: When backlog.py land stops at a step after it released the worker's worktree (lint, eval, stale, a failed push), its stop message names the git worktree add command that checks work/<id> out again at the same path, so the orchestrator fixes the branch without finding the path by hand
at SP-up5wchen the land of ST-4ehra2pk stopped at lint twice and the orchestrator re-added the removed worktree each time

gates.question: How does the land stop message print the removed worktree's path in the git worktree add command: absolute, or relative to the checkout land runs in (every line backlog.py prints withholds the user's name, which an absolute path under a home directory holds)?

notes: Premise: land releases the worker's worktree before it rebases (release_worker_worktree at step branch) and no stop message after that names how to get it back (planned 2026-10-12: bl_land.py holds no 'worktree add' text). Merged ST-iviphkbm (keeping the worktree until the push succeeded): land must release it before the rebase, since git rebase needs the branch free, and the branch keeps every commit after a failed push, so keeping it is not workable; absorbed: the test covers a failed push beside lint. The suite sits at max_ids 100: extend TestStoppedLand's test in test_land_e2e.py and rename it to carry the name the check selects, no new id. No gate: the goal leaves no choice open. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 15 of 19, "Land snags: session-end distill, a stopped land's worktree, an orchestrator behind main and a racy hook test"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates. SP-djl7za6x close: BG-geepi6yv's land stopped at rag.py eval after it had removed the worker's worktree; the orchestrator re-made it by hand (git worktree add .claude/worktrees/agent-BG-geepi6yv work/BG-geepi6yv) to fix two eval rows and re-ran land.
